# Great Business Platforms

> Great Business Platforms Ltd is a London-based AI consultancy and AI training provider for business owners, entrepreneurs and leadership teams. It audits how a business works, builds AI automation into existing tools, and trains teams to use AI well and safely. Registered in England and Wales, company number 08660704.

## What we do

- AI consultancy ("build it with us"): AI readiness assessment, AI workflow audit, AI implementation roadmap, AI workflow automation, AI integration with email and CRM, and Voice AI agents for customer enquiries.
- AI training ("teach us to do it"): corporate AI workshops, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Microsoft Copilot training for marketing, HR and finance teams, Claude Training for Productivity, prompt engineering for business, AI literacy and safe AI use within UK GDPR.
- AI enablement: audit, build, then train, in that order, so the system is used after it is built.

## Service pages

- [AI consultancy](https://greatbusinessplatforms.com/ai-consultancy/): what an AI consultant delivers, the four-stage process, and answers to common questions.
- [AI training for teams](https://greatbusinessplatforms.com/ai-training/): training by team, by tool and by skill, with safe use built in.

## Programmes

- [Business Workflow Development](https://greatbusinessplatforms.com/#programmes): four stages, Process Audit, System Design, Build and Deploy, Team Enablement.
- [Super Productivity in Marketing with AI](https://greatbusinessplatforms.com/#programmes): seven-module AI training programme, no coding required.
- [Business Growth Architecture](https://greatbusinessplatforms.com/#programmes): go-to-market strategy built on the S.C.A.L.E Model.
